notes.title: We are LIVE Today on both STEAM and PLAY STORE
notes.notes:
[h1]STAGDRAFT Release[/h1]
Hey everyone! I know I’ve been a bit quiet lately, and I apologize for not updating you sooner. STAGDRAFT will be released Tomorrow (real). Eventhough there are still a lot of room for improvements, we’re now live just now.

### STAGDRAFT Will be available on:
- Steam
- Google Play Store
(Cross-platform)
there will be three server regions to choose from: USA, EU, and SGP.

[h2]Now What?[/h2]
I can’t thank you all enough for the community support. It was really invaluable (really). Given the time crunch and my limited experience in community management, I felt I had to move forward with the release rather than delay it any longer. I realize this might not be the most polished marketing approach, and I appreciate your patience.

[h2]Current Expectations[/h2]
Whether STAGDRAFT becomes a hit or stays a small community, I’m just happy to share it with all of you. If there are players enjoying the game, that’s a big win, otherwise I'm Ok.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
I’ll be sharing more about this journey in a post-mortem soon, but here are a few highlights:
- I genuinely enjoy creating games like STAGDRAFT, and if time allows, maybe down the line, I could explore a remaster or a rebranding. But let’s see—that’s all just a “maybe” for now.
Why's that I learnt game marketing throughout the project and see the market demands for a similar game type, but thats all for now. I'll update soon certainly

[h2]Post-Mortem[/h2]
This project has been in the works for over three years, and there’s a lot I’ve learned along the way. I’ll be sharing a short article or a video on the whole experience (expect it in about a week)!

I recommend to what the early story for Stagdraft, if you haven't
https://youtu.be/EUatF4fPGuI

(feel free to talk to me on the discord channel though)

notes.title: We are participating in STEAM Next Fest October '24 and BRAND NEW Trailer
notes.notes:
Dear, Warriors!

[h2]Steam Next Fest[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43014481/132a718e14db798bfb6cb626b8b10b62c0bbe98a.png[/img]

A little story, we once tried to participate in 2023 February Steam Next Fest, but we realized the game isn't ready for a PUBLIC DEMO. Once polished and based on the community helps, We're so glad to introduce our participation in this moment

In celebration of the October 2024 edition of Steam Next Fest, we're looking for public opinion about the overall game experience, our new map (Taiga) and overall game direction

Make sure to join the discord to play with our community members.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2305920/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=nextfest

[h2]New Trailer[/h2]
For the past few weeks, we have been working on the new trailer to showcase more diverse game classes and new maps. Based on the previous feedbacks, viewers stating the map looks are too boring and repetitive. Hopefull the new trailer enhance it, I'd like to hear your opinion to be the improvement for our next trailer, please leave it either in discussion or discord!
